line.a_tratwa.text: Look! I built a raft. We'll take the picnic across the brook on it.

line.a_uwaga.text: But careful: if we load it wrong, the raft will tip.

line.a_ojej.text: Oh no! Under Bear the raft sank deep!

line.a_pode_mna.text: Under me the raft hardly moved!

line.a_kto.text: Point to who is heavier: Bear or Bunny.

line.a_kto_nie.text: Under Bunny the raft hardly moved. Under whom did it sink deep?

line.a_kto_tak.text: Yes, Bear is heavier! Under the heavier one the raft sinks deeper.

line.a_rzeczy.text: And our things? The watermelon, the pot, the blanket... Which are heavy and which are light?

line.a_waga.text: We'll check on my balance. Let's go to the workshop!

line.b_waga.text: This is my balance. It has two pans. We put things on them and watch what happens.

line.b_poduszka.text: I know! The pillow is huge, so it's the heaviest. And the stone is tiny, it weighs nothing!

line.b_sprawdzmy.text: Hmm... Let's not guess. Let's check on the balance.

line.b_poloz.text: Put the stone on one pan and the pillow on the other.

line.b_co.text: What? The stone's pan went down!

line.b_metoda.text: Look. The pan that goes down is heavier. The one that goes up is lighter.

line.b_kamyk.text: The stone is small, but heavy. The pillow is big, but light.

line.b_aha.text: Aha! Big doesn't always mean heavy.

line.b_dynia.text: Now guess before you put them on. A pumpkin and a feather. Point to what is heavier.

line.b_dynia_nie.text: The feather is very light. What is heavier?

line.b_sprawdz.text: Good. Now put them on the pans and check.

line.b_dynia_tak.text: The pumpkin's pan went down. The pumpkin is heavier than the feather!

line.b_jablko.text: And now an apple and a nut. Point to what is heavier.

line.b_jablko_nie.text: The nut is small and light. What is heavier?

line.b_jablko_tak.text: The apple is down, because it is heavier. The nut is lighter, so it went up.

line.b_wracamy.text: Now we know how to check what is heavy. Let's go back to the brook!

line.c_chowany.text: Before we sail, let's play hide-and-seek!

line.c_szukam.text: All right, I'll seek. Go and hide!

line.c_ladujemy.text: Got you! And now we load the raft. First let's put the things in order from the lightest to the heaviest.

line.c_uloz.text: The lightest thing goes here, at the start. Put them in order.

line.c_uloz_nie.text: Hmm, not that place. The lightest first, the heaviest last.

line.c_ulozone.text: The balloon is the lightest, then the apple, and the watermelon is the heaviest. Even though the balloon is the biggest!

line.c_jablko.text: We don't need to take the apple. I'll eat it right now. Yum!

line.c_srodek.text: Put the heavy things in the middle of the raft and the light ones on the edges. Then it won't tip.

line.c_srodek_nie.text: Oh no, the raft would tip! Heavy in the middle, light on the edges.

line.c_srodek_tak.text: The watermelon and the pot are in the middle, the balloon and the blanket on the edges. The raft is level!

line.c_ty_srodek.text: You, Bear, sit right in the middle!

line.c_plyniemy.text: Off we go! Heavy in the middle, light on the edges, and the raft doesn't wobble at all.

line.c_brzeg.text: We're on the other bank! Nothing fell in the water.

line.c_dziekuje.text: Thank you for your help! Without you the raft would have tipped.

line.c_zupa.text: After the picnic we'll do the shopping and I'll cook pumpkin soup at my home. You're all invited!

line.p_start.text: Now the weighing school! You get a star for every game.

line.p_kamyk.text: A balloon or a stone? Point to what is heavier.

line.p_kamyk_nie.text: The balloon is big, but light. What is heavier?

line.p_kamyk_tak.text: Yes, the stone! It is small, but heavy.

line.p_mlotek.text: And now a pillow or a hammer? Point to what is heavier.

line.p_mlotek_nie.text: The pillow is soft and light. What is heavier?

line.p_mlotek_tak.text: Yes, the hammer is heavier than the pillow.

line.p_szalka.text: I'll put the stone and the leaf on the balance. Point to the pan that will go down.

line.p_szalka_nie.text: Over this pan there's a light leaf. Which pan will go down?

line.p_szalka_tak.text: Yes! The stone's pan went down, because the stone is heavier.

line.p_kolejka.text: Put the leaf, the apple and the pumpkin in order from the lightest to the heaviest.

line.p_kolejka_nie.text: The lightest first, the heaviest last.

line.p_kolejka_tak.text: The leaf, the apple, the pumpkin. From the lightest to the heaviest!

line.p_rowno.text: There's a jar of honey on one pan. Put apples on the other pan until the balance is level.

line.p_rowno_za_duzo.text: Too many! Now the apples are heavier. Take one apple off.

line.p_rowno_tak.text: Level! The pans are at the same height. Two apples weigh the same as the jar of honey.

line.p_bal.text: This log is very heavy. Point to who can lift it: Bear or Bunny.

line.p_bal_nie.text: Oh no, it's too heavy for me! Who is stronger?

line.p_bal_tak.text: Yes, I can lift it! I'm big and strong.

line.p_balonik.text: And the balloon can only lift someone light. Point to who is lighter.

line.p_balonik_nie.text: I'm too heavy for the balloon. Who is lighter?

line.p_balonik_tak.text: That's me! I'm lighter than Bear. Hop, I'm flying!

line.d_dom.text: Here we are in my kitchen! First we'll unpack the shopping, then I'll cook the soup.

line.d_zajac.text: I know where everything goes! The big bag is heavy, so the bottom shelf. And the little one on top!

line.d_bobr_nie.text: Bunny, does big mean heavy? Remember the stone and the pillow?

line.d_lapki.text: Let's check in our paws. I'll take the potatoes, and you, Bunny, the crisps.

line.d_ktora.text: Point to the bag that is heavier.

line.d_ktora_nie.text: The crisps are big, but light as a feather! Which bag is heavier?

line.d_ktora_tak.text: Yes, the potatoes! A small bag, but so heavy.

line.d_sloiki.text: We also have two jars: a big one of popcorn and a small one of honey.

line.d_nie_zgaduje.text: This time I won't guess. I'll check on the balance!

line.d_poloz.text: Put the jars on the pans.

line.d_sloiki_tak.text: The small honey jar went down! It is heavier than the big popcorn jar.

line.d_polki.text: Now onto the shelves. Heavy things on the lower shelf, light ones on the upper shelf, so nothing falls.

line.d_polki_nie.text: Heavy on the lower shelf, light on the upper one.

line.d_polki_tak.text: The potatoes and the honey below, the crisps and the popcorn on top. Nothing will fall!

line.d_worek.text: There's still my heaviest bag. I covered it with paper. What's inside?

line.d_zdrap.text: Rub the paper off with your finger and see!

line.d_co_ciezkie.text: Point to what makes the bag so heavy.

line.d_co_ciezkie_nie.text: That's light. What is so big and heavy?

line.d_dynia.text: A huge pumpkin! Heavy, very heavy. It will make pumpkin soup.

line.d_zupa.text: Phew! The heavy pot is on the stove. The soup is ready!

line.d_mniam.text: Yum! Heavy below, light on top, and nothing fell.

line.d_pokaz.text: Look: I'm holding a nut, and Bear an apple. The apple is heavier!

line.d_rodzice.text: Play this at home with your parents. Take two things in your hands and say which one is heavier.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping with my raft! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Beaver's raft. He gave it to us when we helped load it well and learnt what is light and what is heavy.

line.d_odkryte.text: The paper is off! Now we can see what makes my bag so heavy.
